def pluspos(f):
    out=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('N','g','p') and n['pixels']>=8:
            b=n['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in b); c0=min(p[1] for p in b)
            out.append((n['color'],r0,c0,n['pixels']))
    return sorted(out)
